title: HTML Review comments sidecar
description: report.comments.json, written next to report.html by the HTML Review tool. Comments point at elements in report.edit.html through their data-eid attribute.

source.description: File name of the original HTML, e.g. report.html

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the original file when the sidecar was last saved

eid.description: data-eid of the element in report.edit.html

quote.description: Selected text. Absent for a comment on the whole element.

prefix.description: Up to 32 characters before the quote

suffix.description: Up to 32 characters after the quote

resolution.description: One line on what was changed, filled in when an agent or person resolves the comment
